findings.summary_md: The Justice Department announced that OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan, 35, a Saudi national employed since July 2025, was arrested on Oct. 9 and charged with using a device to intercept oral communications, making his initial federal court appearance on Oct. 13. OpenAI security found the recorder on Sept. 30 in a USB port behind a television in an executive conference room, concealed in toilet paper, installed around Sept. 28, with encrypted contents. FBI Director Kash Patel and Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton publicly framed the case as a counterintelligence matter tied to protecting American superintelligence technology.
findings.title: Saudi National Arrested for Installing Surreptitious Audio Recording Device at OpenAI
